officialGuide.title: Application Developer Associate Certification Exam Guide (learn.palantir.com)

announcement.title: Palantir certifications are getting a refresh (Palantir Developer Community, 27 July 2026, updated 3 August 2026)

summary: This simulator follows the 2026 Application Developer Certification Guide its author studied from (60 questions, 120 minutes, four weighted sections). Palantir refreshed its Associate exams on 3 August 2026, and the current official Associate guide describes a different exam. Treat a pass here as evidence of topic knowledge, not as a prediction of the live exam result.

rows.simulator: Forward-only: no return to a question after advancing
Single-select, multi-select, discrete options, hotspot, matching
rows.official: The launch announcement describes the Associate exams as multiple-choice. Hotspot, matching and discrete options are not mentioned.

rows.simulator: Practice only, plus an optional mix in mock forms labelled as a practice variation
rows.official: Not mentioned in the official guide or the announcement

rows.simulator: Four sections: Application Design 30%, Application Implementation 30%, UX and Cross-Application Workflows 20%, Application Maintenance 20%
rows.official: Eight domains, no published weights: Ontology Schema Design and Workflow Assembly; Action Types and Write-Back Patterns; Ontology Functions; Workshop Application Development; OSDK, APIs, and External Applications; Automate and Operational Workflows; AIP Logic and AI-Powered Applications; Application Security, Governance, and Operations

rows.topic: Topics the simulator does not cover
rows.simulator: Quiver, Scenarios, Foundry Rules, Object Views and Carbon are covered because the baseline guide lists them
rows.official: OSDK and external applications, Automate, AIP Logic, Python functions, and security and governance are exam domains that this question bank covers only in passing or not at all

rows.simulator: Runs in your browser, no proctoring
rows.official: Timed and open-book per the announcement, valid for two years
